description: Use when the user asks which Pokémon cards are rising or falling, what is hot, or the biggest moves this week/month. lang = "en" / "ja" / "zh-cn" (market tracks never mix). direction = "up" (cards rising) or "down" (cards falling), default "up". window = "7d" / "30d" / "90d"; omit to use the default window published for that track. Every row passes a liquidity gate — at least 5 verified sales in both the current and the base window, change capped at ±40%, both medians consistent with the card's reference price — and carries price_now / price_base / n_cur / n_prev, so a listed move is a real same-card, same-grade move. Up to 20 cards. Reads POKEKA market data only; server-side request logging is disclosed in the privacy policy; does not modify user data.

window.description: Change window: "7d", "30d" or "90d". Omit to use the default window published for that track.

name: market_movers

anchor_date.description: The window anchors to this latest-sale date; present it.

grade.description: Representative grade being compared (e.g. "PSA 10") — pools never mix grades.

price_basis.description: "reference" = price_usd is NOT a robust verified-sales median (price_method names the kind) — say so when quoting it.

price_grade.description: present when price_usd is at a different grade than the grade of this row

price_method.description: kind of reference: market_reference / limited_sales_reference / historical_reference

reason.description: present when the board is empty because this track does not publish this window (not because nothing moved) — read note

title: Market movers
